citations.claim: first pole_upright violation: pole angle -0.887 rad exceeds 0.8 limit, cart at x=1.61 still on track
one step before violation pole already at -0.688 rad and diverging with controller saturated
system energy at violating step shows large controller work injected

explanation: Controller saturates at force_limit 40 for many steps while light cart (0.5) with heavy long pole and initial offset x=0.5,v=0.5,theta=0.1 plus sensor noise 0.02 cannot stabilize at dt=0.02; pole rate grows from -8.5 to -10.3 rad/s over steps 9-11 and angle blows past 0.8 rad. Likely gain/noise interaction and coarse dt make feedback destabilizing rather than balancing.
vision_note: The pole tilts progressively farther to the left across steps 8 to 10 while the cart drifts rightward toward the wall. At step 11 the pole is sharply angled and highlighted red as the violating body.
